Indikator 7 tracks the incidence of severe bleeding (alvorlig blødning) per 100 patient-years among prevalent patients with [[atrieflimren]], as monitored by the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]]. Across three consecutive annual reports (2023, 2024, and 2025), the data reveals a highly stable national bleeding rate hovering around 2.1 to 2.2 per 100 patient-years, but a universal failure to meet the established clinical standard. In every reported period, across all [[regioner]] and [[sundhedsklynger|Sundhedsklyngerne]], the target compliance rate remained at 0% [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

When examining the regional leaders (lowest bleeding rates) and trailers (highest bleeding rates), [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] consistently performed best in the earlier periods, recording a rate of 1.9 in both the 2022/23 and 2023/24 periods [^src1] [^src2]. However, in the latest period, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] emerged as the regional leader with the lowest rate at 2.1, while Midtjylland's rate increased to 2.2 [^src3]. On the other end of the spectrum, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] and [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] tied for the highest regional rates (2.3) in 2022/23 [^src1], while [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] tied for the highest (2.3) in the latest period [^src3].

At the health cluster level, notable outliers and trends emerge. [[sundhedsklynge-fyn|Sundhedsklynge Fyn]] consistently records some of the highest severe bleeding rates, rising from 2.5 in 2023/24 to 2.8 in the latest period, making it the highest-ranking cluster for this adverse outcome [^src2] [^src3]. Conversely, [[sundhedsklynge-sydvestjylland|Sundhedsklynge Sydvestjylland]] was a standout leader in the 2023/24 period with an exceptionally low rate of 1.6, though this increased to 2.0 in the following year [^src2] [^src3]. [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]] also shows an upward trend, moving from 2.3 to 2.7 over the last two periods [^src2] [^src3]. Despite these local fluctuations, the national aggregate remains remarkably flat, underscoring a systemic challenge in reducing severe bleeding events among this patient population nationwide. The complete annual reports encompassing these data also detail extensive methodological frameworks, additional quality indicators, and organizational governance structures for the registry [^src4] [^src5] [^src6] [^src7] [^src8] [^src9] [^src10] [^src11] [^src12] [^src13] [^src14] [^src15] [^src16] [^src17] [^src18] [^src19] [^src20] [^src21] [^src22] [^src23] [^src24] [^src25] [^src26] [^src27] [^src28] [^src29] [^src30] [^src31] [^src32] [^src33] [^src34] [^src35] [^src36] [^src37] [^src38] [^src39] [^src40] [^src41] [^src42] [^src43] [^src44] [^src45] [^src46] [^src47] [^src48] [^src49] [^src50] [^src51] [^src52].

- "Såfremt de anførte 95% CI for indikatorværdien ikke omfatter standardværdien, kan det konkluderes, at afdelingen ligger enten over eller under den opstillede standard, og at forskellen i forhold til standarden ikke kan forklares ved tilfældig variation. Der foreligger med andre ord en statistisk signifikant forskel" — see [[statistical-interpretation|Statistical Interpretation]] ([[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]]) [^src49]
- "Omfaatter 95% CI derimod standardværdien, er det ikke muligt at afgøre om indikatorværdien med sikkerhed adskiller sig fra den opstillede standard" — see [[statistical-interpretation|Statistical Interpretation]] ([[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]]) [^src49]
- "For Indikator 7 var incidensen for hele Danmark 2,2 % (95 % CI: 2,1–2,3) i perioden 01.07.2024–30.06.2025" — see [[quality-indicator-result|Quality Indicator Result]] (Indikator 7) [^src51]
- "Der ses en fortsat positiv udvikling i Region Hovedstaden, imens udviklingen er mere stagnerende i Sjælland og Nordjylland" — see [[performance-trend|Performance Trend]] ([[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden — Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland — Sjælland]], [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland — Nordjylland]]) [^src19]
- "Region Sjælland vurderer, at resultaterne for indikator 8 ikke stemmer overens med den kliniske virkelighed" — see [[critical-assessment|Critical Assessment]] ([[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland — Sjælland]]) [^src52]
- "Region Sjælland har iværksat en intern undersøgelse af registrerings- og dataflow-fejl i forbindelse med indikator 8" — see [[quality-improvement-action|Quality Improvement Action]] ([[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland — Sjælland]]) [^src52]
